Ui.Script:
-- Fork deviation requested for local-world administration. Every widget uses stock -- 1.12 templates/art. The Rust interface is an untrusted-input boundary, never a GM chat command. local actions = { { "item", "Items / Bags", "Grant Item", "Search the validated Classic item catalog by name or item ID, including all bag sizes. Granting an item does not imply every use or equip effect is supported.", "Count (1-200)", "1" }, { "gold", "Gold", "Grant Gold", "Classic money: 1 gold = 10,000 copper. The authority checks the character's balance and commits the grant atomically.", "Gold (1-10,000)", "1" }, { "mount", "Mounts", "Grant Mount", "Choose a supported mount from this world's catalog. This grants the real supported mount; it does not swap the character's appearance.", nil, "" }, { "speed", "Movement Speed", "Set Speed", "Movement changes require the world's authoritative movement and acknowledgement path. 100% restores the normal admin speed setting.", "Speed % (100-300)", "100" }, { "teleport", "City Teleport", "Teleport", "Choose a major city supported by this world. The authority validates its map, destination and current session before moving the character.", nil, "" }, { "level", "Level +1", "Gain +1 Level", "Instantly gain exactly one level, up to this world's supported Classic maximum. The authority applies the full level-up state changes.", nil, "" }, { "xp", "XP Gain", "", "On: receive XP normally. Off: keep current XP and level, but receive no further XP from any source. The setting must persist with the character.", nil, "" }, { "reputation", "Reputation", "Adjust Reputation", "Choose a supported faction. Positive points increase reputation; negative points decrease it. The authority validates faction rules and limits.", "Points (-42,999 to +42,999; nonzero)", "100" }, { "honor", "Honor Points", "Grant Honor", "Classic honor contribution is tracked by day and week. Honorable kills and PvP rank are separate. Requires a durable, authorized honor backend.", "Contribution points (1-100,000)", "1" }, { "time", "Time of Day", "Set World Time", "Set the world clock for all participants, in 24-hour time. Enter auto to return to the automatic world clock. This is not a local lighting override.", "HH:MM (00:00-23:59), or auto", "12:00" }, { "weather", "Weather", "Set Weather", "Choose a validated weather option for your current location, including Automatic to restore normal weather. The world authority rechecks location and applies it consistently.", nil, "" }, } local catalogActions = { item = 1, mount = 1, teleport = 1, reputation = 1, weather = 1 } local selected, page, cursor = 1, 1, 1 local currentView, results, choice, lastQuery, lastAction, lastGeneration local browsing = false
local function setEnabled(button, enabled) if enabled then button:Enable() else button:Disable() end end
local function clearSelection() choice, page, cursor, browsing = nil, 1, 1, false if GameTooltip then GameTooltip:Hide() end end
function BenillaAdmin_Select(index) selected = index clearSelection() lastAction = nil BenillaAdminFrameSearch:SetText("") BenillaAdminFrameAmount:SetText(actions[index][6]) BenillaAdminFrameSearch:ClearFocus() BenillaAdminFrameAmount:ClearFocus() BenillaAdmin_Refresh() end
function BenillaAdmin_Page(direction) BenillaAdmin_Refresh() if not results or results.pages == 0 then return end page = math.max(1, math.min(results.pages, page + direction)) choice, cursor = nil, 1 BenillaAdmin_Refresh() end
function BenillaAdmin_Browse() BenillaAdmin_Refresh() BenillaAdminFrameSearch:ClearFocus() browsing = true BenillaAdmin_Refresh() end
function BenillaAdmin_Choose(index) -- Recheck the row being clicked, rather than choosing a replacement from a newer -- world, query or page that happened to occupy the same screen position. local oldResults = results local old = oldResults and oldResults.entries[index] local query = BenillaAdminFrameSearch:GetText() local oldQuery = lastQuery BenillaAdmin_Refresh() local entry = results and results.entries[index] if not old or not entry or query ~= oldQuery or old.id ~= entry.id or oldResults.generation ~= results.generation then return end choice, cursor, browsing = entry, index, false BenillaAdminFrameSearch:ClearFocus() BenillaAdmin_Refresh() end
function BenillaAdmin_Key(key) if key == "ESCAPE" then ToggleGameMenu(); return end if not catalogActions[actions[selected][1]] then return end if key == "TAB" then browsing = false BenillaAdminFrameSearch:SetFocus() elseif browsing and (key == "LEFT" or key == "RIGHT") then BenillaAdmin_Page(key == "LEFT" and -1 or 1) elseif browsing and (key == "UP" or key == "DOWN") then BenillaAdmin_Refresh() local direction = key == "UP" and -1 or 1 local next = cursor + direction if results and next > table.getn(results.entries) and page < results.pages then BenillaAdmin_Page(1) elseif next < 1 and page > 1 then BenillaAdmin_Page(-1) cursor = table.getn(results.entries) elseif results then cursor = math.max(1, math.min(table.getn(results.entries), next)) end BenillaAdmin_Refresh() elseif browsing and key == "ENTER" then BenillaAdmin_Choose(cursor) end end
function BenillaAdmin_Tooltip(index) local entry = results and results.entries[index] if not entry or not GameTooltip then return end GameTooltip:SetOwner(this, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") GameTooltip:SetText(entry.label, 1, 1, 1, 1) GameTooltip:AddLine("Catalog ID: " .. entry.id, 1, 0.82, 0, 1) GameTooltip:AddLine("Catalog visibility does not guarantee this entry's gameplay support. Apply rechecks readiness and permissions.", 1, 1, 1, 1) GameTooltip:Show() end
function BenillaAdmin_Refresh() if not BenillaAdminFrameApply then return end local spec = actions[selected] currentView = BenillaAdminGetView and BenillaAdminGetView() or { identity = "No verified world admin", status = "Admin gameplay backend unavailable in this session.", message = "", generation = "", } local capability = currentView[spec[1]] or { enabled = false, reason = "Admin gameplay backend unavailable in this session.", } local query = BenillaAdminFrameSearch:GetText() if lastQuery ~= query or lastAction ~= selected or lastGeneration ~= currentView.generation then clearSelection() end lastQuery, lastAction, lastGeneration = query, selected, currentView.generation local catalog = catalogActions[spec[1]] results = catalog and BenillaAdminSearch and BenillaAdminSearch(spec[1], query, page) or { entries = {}, page = 0, pages = 0, total = 0, reason = "", generation = currentView.generation, } -- A backend may change between the view and search snapshots. Never keep a choice -- from either prior generation; the next refresh will acquire matching capabilities. if results.generation ~= currentView.generation then clearSelection() end page = math.max(1, results.page) cursor = math.max(1, math.min(cursor, table.getn(results.entries))) BenillaAdminFrameIdentity:SetText(currentView.identity) BenillaAdminFrameContext:SetText(currentView.status) BenillaAdminFrameOperationTitle:SetText(spec[2]) BenillaAdminFrameHelp:SetText(spec[4]) local reason = capability.reason if reason == "" and currentView.pending then reason = "Waiting for the pending request's authoritative result." end if reason == "" and results.reason ~= "" then reason = results.reason end if reason == "" then reason = catalog and "Choose an entry, then use the action button. The backend rechecks support and admin permission." or "Available to the verified world admin" end BenillaAdminFrameReason:SetText(reason) BenillaAdminFrameResult:SetText(currentView.message) for i = 1, table.getn(actions) do getglobal("BenillaAdminAction" .. i):SetButtonState(i == selected and "PUSHED" or "NORMAL", i == selected) end for _, widget in ipairs({ BenillaAdminFrameSearch, BenillaAdminFrameSearchLabel, BenillaAdminFrameChoice, BenillaAdminFramePageCount, BenillaAdminFrameBrowseHelp, BenillaAdminFramePrevious, BenillaAdminFrameNext }) do if catalog then widget:Show() else widget:Hide() end end for i = 1, 5 do local row = getglobal("BenillaAdminResult" .. i) local entry = results.entries[i] if catalog and entry then row:SetText(entry.display_label .. " [" .. entry.id .. "]") local active = choice and choice.id == entry.id or browsing and cursor == i row:SetButtonState(active and "PUSHED" or "NORMAL", active) row:Show() else row:Hide() end end BenillaAdminFrameChoice:SetText(choice and ("Selected: " .. choice.display_label .. " [" .. choice.id .. "]") or (results.total > 0 and "Select a result to prepare this action" or "No matching entries in this world's catalog")) local first = results.total > 0 and ((page - 1) * results.page_size + 1) or 0 local last = results.total > 0 and (first + table.getn(results.entries) - 1) or 0 BenillaAdminFramePageCount:SetText("Page " .. results.page .. " / " .. results.pages .. " | " .. first .. "-" .. last .. " of " .. results.total) setEnabled(BenillaAdminFramePrevious, page > 1) setEnabled(BenillaAdminFrameNext, page < results.pages) if spec[5] then BenillaAdminFrameAmountLabel:SetText(spec[5]) BenillaAdminFrameAmountLabel:Show() BenillaAdminFrameAmount:Show() else BenillaAdminFrameAmountLabel:Hide() BenillaAdminFrameAmount:Hide() end local label = spec[3] if spec[1] == "xp" then if currentView.xp_enabled == nil then label = "XP Control Unavailable" elseif currentView.xp_enabled then label = "Turn XP Gain Off" else label = "Turn XP Gain On" end elseif spec[1] == "level" and currentView.current_level then label = "Gain +1 Level (" .. currentView.current_level .. "/" .. currentView.max_level .. ")" end BenillaAdminFrameApply:SetText(label) setEnabled(BenillaAdminFrameApply, capability.enabled and results.reason == "" and (not catalog or choice)) end
function BenillaAdmin_Apply() BenillaAdmin_Refresh() local spec = actions[selected] local capability = currentView and currentView[spec[1]] if not capability or not capability.enabled or not BenillaAdminSubmit or results.reason ~= "" or (catalogActions[spec[1]] and not choice) then return end local amount = BenillaAdminFrameAmount:GetText() if spec[1] == "xp" then amount = currentView.xp_enabled and "off" or "on" end BenillaAdminSubmit(spec[1], choice and choice.id or "", amount, currentView.generation) BenillaAdminFrameAmount:ClearFocus() BenillaAdmin_Refresh() end
function BenillaAdmin_OnLoad() UIPanelWindows["BenillaAdminFrame"] = { area = "center", pushable = 0, whileDead = 1 } for index, spec in ipairs(actions) do local row = CreateFrame("Button", "BenillaAdminAction" .. index, this, "UIPanelButtonTemplate") row:SetWidth(134) row:SetHeight(22) row:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", this, "TOPLEFT", 20, -77 - (index - 1) * 27) row:SetText(spec[2]) row:SetID(index) row:SetScript("OnClick", function() BenillaAdmin_Select(this:GetID()) end) end for index = 1, 5 do local row = CreateFrame("Button", "BenillaAdminResult" .. index, this, "UIPanelButtonTemplate") row:SetWidth(380) row:SetHeight(22) row:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", this, "TOPLEFT", 176, -218 - (index - 1) * 24) row:SetID(index) row:SetScript("OnClick", function() BenillaAdmin_Choose(this:GetID()) end) row:SetScript("OnEnter", function() BenillaAdmin_Tooltip(this:GetID()) end) row:SetScript("OnLeave", function() if GameTooltip then GameTooltip:Hide() end end) end end

Ui.Script:
-- Fork-only profile-signed local-world setup. Saving or selecting a declaration never -- attaches a gameplay backend or turns this form into an authorization credential. local setupView, setupContext, setupRevision local setupMode, setupPage, setupChoice = "saved", 1, nil local setupNotice = "" local function setupEnabled(button, enabled) if enabled then button:Enable() else button:Disable() end end local function setupVisible(widget, visible) if visible then widget:Show() else widget:Hide() end end local function setupFields() local label = string.gsub(BenillaWorldSetupFrameName:GetText(), "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1") if string.len(label) == 0 or string.len(label) > 40 or string.find(label, "[^A-Za-z0-9 _%-]") then return nil, "Enter a name with 1-40 ASCII letters, numbers, spaces, hyphens or underscores." end local seen, count = {}, 0 for id in string.gfind(BenillaWorldSetupFrameAdmins:GetText(), "[^,%s]+") do id = string.lower(id) if string.len(id) ~= 32 or string.find(id, "[^0-9a-f]") or id == string.rep("0", 32) then return nil, "Each additional admin owner ID must contain exactly 32 hexadecimal characters and cannot be all zeroes." end if id == setupView.owner_id then return nil, "The current owner already has permission. Leave their ID out of the additional list." end if seen[id] then return nil, "An additional admin ID is repeated. Enter each owner ID once." end seen[id], count = true, count + 1 if count > 64 then return nil, "At most 64 additional admin owner IDs can be saved." end end return count, "" end function BenillaWorldSetup_Mode(mode) setupMode, setupChoice, setupNotice = mode, nil, "" BenillaWorldSetupFrameName:ClearFocus() BenillaWorldSetupFrameAdmins:ClearFocus() BenillaWorldSetup_Refresh() if mode == "new" then BenillaWorldSetupFrameName:SetFocus() end end function BenillaWorldSetup_Page(direction) BenillaWorldSetup_Refresh() setupPage = math.max(1, math.min(math.max(1, math.ceil(table.getn(setupView.worlds) / 5)), setupPage + direction)) setupChoice = nil BenillaWorldSetup_Refresh() end function BenillaWorldSetup_Choose(index) local oldView = setupView local world = oldView and oldView.worlds[(setupPage - 1) * 5 + index] BenillaWorldSetup_Refresh() if not world or oldView.context ~= setupView.context or oldView.revision ~= setupView.revision then return end setupChoice = world BenillaWorldSetup_Refresh() end function BenillaWorldSetup_Save() local context, revision = setupContext, setupRevision BenillaWorldSetup_Refresh() local count = setupFields() if not setupView.available or setupView.pending or not count or table.getn(setupView.worlds) >= 16 or context ~= setupContext or revision ~= setupRevision or not BenillaWorldSetupCreate then return end BenillaWorldSetupCreate(BenillaWorldSetupFrameName:GetText(), BenillaWorldSetupFrameAdmins:GetText(), context, revision) BenillaWorldSetupFrameName:ClearFocus() BenillaWorldSetupFrameAdmins:ClearFocus() BenillaWorldSetup_Refresh() end function BenillaWorldSetup_Use() local context, revision, world = setupContext, setupRevision, setupChoice BenillaWorldSetup_Refresh() if not setupView.available or setupView.pending or not setupChoice or setupChoice.selected or world ~= setupChoice or context ~= setupContext or revision ~= setupRevision or not BenillaWorldSetupSelect then return end BenillaWorldSetupSelect(world.id, context, revision) BenillaWorldSetup_Refresh() end function BenillaWorldSetup_Refresh() if not BenillaWorldSetupFrameSave then return end setupView = BenillaWorldSetupGetView and BenillaWorldSetupGetView() or { available = false, pending = false, message = "", status = "Local-world setup backend unavailable in this session.", owner_id = "", context = "", revision = "0", worlds = {}, selected_id = "", } if setupContext ~= setupView.context or setupRevision ~= setupView.revision then if setupContext then setupNotice = "Setup changed. Review the current owner and saved worlds before continuing." end setupChoice, setupPage = nil, 1 BenillaWorldSetupFrameName:SetText("") BenillaWorldSetupFrameAdmins:SetText("") end setupContext, setupRevision = setupView.context, setupView.revision local creating = setupMode == "new" local total = math.min(16, table.getn(setupView.worlds)) local pages = math.ceil(total / 5) setupPage = math.max(1, math.min(math.max(1, pages), setupPage)) BenillaWorldSetupFrameOwner:SetText(setupView.owner_id ~= "" and ("Current profile owner: " .. setupView.owner_id) or "No current profile owner") BenillaWorldSetupFrameStatus:SetText(setupView.status) BenillaWorldSetupFrameSavedTab:SetButtonState(creating and "NORMAL" or "PUSHED", not creating) BenillaWorldSetupFrameNewTab:SetButtonState(creating and "PUSHED" or "NORMAL", creating) for i = 1, 5 do local row = getglobal("BenillaWorldSetupRow" .. i) local world = setupView.worlds[(setupPage - 1) * 5 + i] if world and not creating then row:SetText(world.label .. (world.selected and " (saved selection)" or "")) local chosen = setupChoice and setupChoice.id == world.id row:SetButtonState(chosen and "PUSHED" or "NORMAL", chosen) row:Show() else row:Hide() end end for _, widget in ipairs({ BenillaWorldSetupFrameNameLabel, BenillaWorldSetupFrameName, BenillaWorldSetupFrameAdminsLabel, BenillaWorldSetupFrameAdmins, BenillaWorldSetupFrameAdminsHelp, BenillaWorldSetupFrameReview, BenillaWorldSetupFrameSave }) do setupVisible(widget, creating) end for _, widget in ipairs({ BenillaWorldSetupFramePrevious, BenillaWorldSetupFrameNext, BenillaWorldSetupFramePageCount, BenillaWorldSetupFrameChoice, BenillaWorldSetupFrameUse }) do setupVisible(widget, not creating) end BenillaWorldSetupFramePageCount:SetText("Page " .. (total == 0 and 0 or setupPage) .. " / " .. pages .. " | " .. total .. " saved worlds") setupEnabled(BenillaWorldSetupFramePrevious, setupPage > 1) setupEnabled(BenillaWorldSetupFrameNext, setupPage < pages) BenillaWorldSetupFrameChoice:SetText(setupChoice and (setupChoice.label .. "
World: " .. setupChoice.id .. "
Owner: " .. setupChoice.owner_id .. "
Additional admins: " .. table.getn(setupChoice.allowlist)) or (total == 0 and "No local worlds saved. Choose New World to prepare one." or "Choose a saved world, then Select Saved World.")) local count, validation = setupFields() BenillaWorldSetupFrameReview:SetText(count and ("Save and select a new local world owned by " .. setupView.owner_id .. "; " .. count .. " other admins.

This immutable setup cannot be edited. Gameplay and grants remain unavailable.") or validation) local reason = setupNotice if not setupView.available then reason = setupView.status elseif setupView.pending then reason = "Waiting for the durable setup result. Closing this window does not cancel it." elseif creating and total >= 16 then reason = "The 16-world save limit has been reached." elseif creating and not count then reason = validation end BenillaWorldSetupFrameReason:SetText(reason) BenillaWorldSetupFrameResult:SetText(setupView.message) setupEnabled(BenillaWorldSetupFrameSave, setupView.available and not setupView.pending and count ~= nil and total < 16) setupEnabled(BenillaWorldSetupFrameUse, setupView.available and not setupView.pending and setupChoice ~= nil and not setupChoice.selected) end function BenillaWorldSetup_OnLoad() UIPanelWindows["BenillaWorldSetupFrame"] = { area = "center", pushable = 0, whileDead = 1 } for i = 1, 5 do local row = CreateFrame("Button", "BenillaWorldSetupRow" .. i, this, "UIPanelButtonTemplate") row:SetWidth(530); row:SetHeight(22) row:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", this, "TOPLEFT", 24, -126 - (i - 1) * 24) row:SetID(i) row:SetScript("OnClick", function() BenillaWorldSetup_Choose(this:GetID()) end) end end function BenillaWorldSetup_Open() HideUIPanel(BenillaAdminFrame) ShowUIPanel(BenillaWorldSetupFrame) end function BenillaWorldSetup_Back() HideUIPanel(BenillaWorldSetupFrame) ShowUIPanel(BenillaAdminFrame) end function BenillaWorldSetup_OnShow() this:SetScale(math.min(1, GetScreenWidth() / 604, GetScreenHeight() / 624)) setupContext, setupRevision, setupNotice = nil, nil, "" setupMode, setupPage, setupChoice = "saved", 1, nil BenillaWorldSetup_Refresh() if UpdateMicroButtons then UpdateMicroButtons() end PlaySound("igMainMenuOpen") end

Ui.Script:
-- ══ The frame: the era layout, 28+144+28 wide, 32 top, 28 bottom, 8 rungs of 21 and -- three gaps of 20 ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ GameMenuFrame:SetWidth(200) GameMenuFrame:SetHeight(288)
-- The stock title (`GameMenuFrame.xml:36`) has no name: found as addons find it. for _, region in ipairs({ GameMenuFrame:GetRegions() }) do if region:GetObjectType() == "FontString" and region:GetText() == MAIN_MENU then region:SetFontObject(BenillaGameFontNormalMed1) end end
-- BENILLA_ERA_WINDOW_SCALE (OptionsFrame.xml) stands in for the era's UIParent scale; -- read at every show, then the stock OnShow. local Ref_GameMenuFrame_OnShow = GameMenuFrame:GetScript("OnShow") GameMenuFrame:SetScript("OnShow", function() this:SetScale(BENILLA_ERA_WINDOW_SCALE or 1) Ref_GameMenuFrame_OnShow() end)
-- ══ The rungs ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -- Every stock rung stays, anchored TOP to a BOTTOM as in the stock file, so an addon's -- `SetPoint("TOP", …)` replaces its one anchor. The three the era menu lacks are hidden -- in place, with Sound and UI Options each laid over the rung above it, so they take no -- space: a width or height of 0 is no size in 1.12's layout, not a flat rect.
-- Literal: 1.12 has no GAMEMENU_OPTIONS; its OPTIONS_MENU is "Options Menu". GameMenuButtonOptions:SetText("Options") GameMenuButtonOptions:ClearAllPoints() GameMenuButtonOptions:SetPoint("TOP", GameMenuFrame, "TOP", 0, -32) GameMenuButtonOptions:SetScript("OnClick", function() PlaySound("igMainMenuOption") HideUIPanel(GameMenuFrame) ShowUIPanel(BenillaOptionsFrame) end)
for _, fold in ipairs({ { GameMenuButtonSoundOptions, GameMenuButtonOptions }, { GameMenuButtonUIOptions, GameMenuButtonSoundOptions }, }) do local button, above = fold[1], fold[2] button:Hide() button:ClearAllPoints() button:SetPoint("TOP", above, "BOTTOM", 0, button:GetHeight()) end -- Key Bindings keeps its stock anchor, 1 under UI Options: the era rungs hang from its -- top, so an addon that inserts a button above it and re-anchors it under that button -- (ShaguTweaks) moves them down as it moves the stock rungs. GameMenuButtonKeybindings:Hide()
-- Fork-only Admin rung, using the same stock button template as the game menu. local admin = CreateFrame("Button", "BenillaGameMenuButtonAdmin", GameMenuFrame, "GameMenuButtonTemplate") admin:SetPoint("TOP", GameMenuButtonKeybindings, "TOP", 0, -19) admin:SetText("Admin") admin:SetScript("OnClick", function() PlaySound("igMainMenuOption") HideUIPanel(GameMenuFrame) ShowUIPanel(BenillaAdminFrame) end)
-- The era's Edit Mode and Support, with nothing behind them yet: disabled. local editMode = CreateFrame("Button", "BenillaGameMenuButtonEditMode", GameMenuFrame, "GameMenuButtonTemplate") editMode:SetPoint("TOP", admin, "BOTTOM", 0, 0) editMode:SetText("Edit Mode") editMode:Disable() local support = CreateFrame("Button", "BenillaGameMenuButtonSupport", GameMenuFrame, "GameMenuButtonTemplate") support:SetPoint("TOP", editMode, "BOTTOM", 0, 0) support:SetText("Support") support:Disable()
GameMenuButtonMacros:SetPoint("TOP", support, "BOTTOM", 0, 0) GameMenuButtonLogout:SetPoint("TOP", GameMenuButtonMacros, "BOTTOM", 0, -20) GameMenuButtonQuit:SetPoint("TOP", GameMenuButtonLogout, "BOTTOM", 0, 0) GameMenuButtonContinue:SetPoint("TOP", GameMenuButtonQuit, "BOTTOM", 0, -20)
-- ══ Our options window in the stock "is an options window open?" checks ═══════════════ -- Each wraps the stock function to add `BenillaOptionsFrame`. local Ref_IsOptionFrameOpen = IsOptionFrameOpen local Ref_ToggleGameMenu = ToggleGameMenu local Ref_UpdateMicroButtons = UpdateMicroButtons
-- Guarded for a test kit that loads the game menu without the options window. local function BenillaOptions_IsOpen() return BenillaOptionsFrame and BenillaOptionsFrame:IsVisible() end
-- `UIParent.lua:996`: a yes keeps the ESC sweep off the centre panel, which our window is. function IsOptionFrameOpen() if BenillaWorldSetupFrame:IsVisible() then return 1 end if BenillaAdminFrame:IsVisible() then return 1 end if BenillaOptions_IsOpen() then return 1 end return Ref_IsOptionFrameOpen() end
-- `UIParent.lua:1465-1497`: static popup, then an open options window, then the stock -- ladder. Our Close click is the discard-and-hide of the reference's `OptionsFrameCancel`. function ToggleGameMenu(clicked) if clicked then if BenillaWorldSetupFrame:IsVisible() then HideUIPanel(BenillaWorldSetupFrame) end if BenillaAdminFrame:IsVisible() then HideUIPanel(BenillaAdminFrame) end -- As the reference's `clicked` arm: close an options window, then toggle. if BenillaOptions_IsOpen() then BenillaOptionsFrameCloseButton:Click() end return Ref_ToggleGameMenu(clicked) end if StaticPopup_EscapePressed() then return end if BenillaWorldSetupFrame:IsVisible() then HideUIPanel(BenillaWorldSetupFrame) return end if BenillaAdminFrame:IsVisible() then HideUIPanel(BenillaAdminFrame) return end if BenillaOptions_IsOpen() then BenillaOptionsFrameCloseButton:Click() return end return Ref_ToggleGameMenu(clicked) end
-- `MainMenuBarMicroButtons.lua:47-58`: only ever pushes the button, so the stock decision -- stands and ours adds our window. Guarded for a test kit that loads no micro buttons. function UpdateMicroButtons() if Ref_UpdateMicroButtons then Ref_UpdateMicroButtons() end if MainMenuMicroButton and (BenillaOptions_IsOpen() or BenillaAdminFrame:IsVisible() or BenillaWorldSetupFrame:IsVisible()) then MainMenuMicroButton:SetButtonState("PUSHED", 1) end end
